reviews.text:
We absolutely loved Masha's support when our dog arrived! She's super friendly, attentive, and above all, very gentle with dogs. She takes the time to explain things simply and gives lots of easy-to-use tips for everyday life.

We learned so much from her and really felt a difference in the start of our relationship with our puppy. A trustworthy and caring person whom we wholeheartedly recommend!

I entrusted Yoshi to Masha and everything went very well.

She is gentle, responsible, punctual, and immediately puts you at ease. She picked him up in the morning while I was out, everything went perfectly, and I found my dog ​​relaxed and well cared for. 🐶 You can tell she truly loves animals. I wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone looking for a trustworthy pet sitter.

I highly recommend Masha if you're looking for a trustworthy dog ​​trainer. She's worked with my dog ​​on several occasions, both individually and during group walks. Very professional and attentive, Udon is always delighted to see her!

Masha looked after Tequila, my 8-month-old dachshund, for 5 days and it went wonderfully. Masha lives near the Buttes Chaumont park, which is perfect for long walks. She has a lovely dog ​​who got along wonderfully with Tequila, and she was also able to socialize with other dogs that Masha was looking after occasionally during that time. We picked her up in excellent health, and we would definitely trust her again in the future! Thank you, Masha! ☺️🫶

We highly recommend Masha, who worked with Madu when he was a puppy. She taught him essential basics and very important commands for his daily safety (stop, leave it, walk on the sidewalk, etc.).

We really appreciated her way of explaining things: she is very clear, patient, and offers a simple, progressive, and tailored method, step by step. Thanks to her guidance, we were able to better understand our dog and have the foundation to build a wonderful relationship with him.

In addition, I particularly loved her sensitivity and kind approach. Madu bonded with her immediately from their very first meeting, which reassured us greatly because he is sometimes a little timid around other people.

We also met her little dog during a walk, and she is a sweetheart and a testament to Masha's talent!

Thank you, Masha, for your guidance, your patience, and everything you have shared with Madu and with us. I recommend her without hesitation!

After just three sessions with Masha, I saw a huge difference in my four-month-old puppy's behavior.

She has a very positive approach to dog training, showing and explaining the best habits to help Snoopy learn. I'm going to take a break for the holidays and resume sessions in the fall to give myself time to absorb everything and practice.

A huge thank you to Masha for her support! Kind, attentive, and always offering great advice, she helped us tremendously to better understand our dog and to progress together.
You can tell she's passionate and truly loves animals. I recommend her without hesitation!

Masha has looked after my Italian Greyhound on several occasions, both for walks and longer periods. I've had bad experiences with trainers and walkers in the past. Masha immediately put me at ease, and my dog ​​loves spending time with her. She lives near the Ourcq and Saint-Martin canals, the Parc de la Villette, and the Buttes Chaumont park. She is very patient and has a great understanding of canine behavior. I highly recommend her dog-sitting and training services.
Masha has looked after my cocker spaniel Holly several times and I had complete confidence in her. I highly recommend her services, both for pet sitting and training!

Masha is a great listener. She has a natural connection with animals; you can tell it's her profession!

She helped me understand the reasons for my dog's problems (he's very fearful) and helped us adapt better to the fast-paced life in Paris.

Go for it!

Masha is an exceptional dog trainer: patient, caring, and very attentive to both dogs and their owners. Thanks to her clear and effective advice, progress was rapid and lasting. I recommend her without hesitation!

Masha is a dog trainer, but also a trainer for owners!

She was able to readjust my mother's dog's behavior after the move had thrown her off balance. Thanks to her attentive listening, her communication skills, and her kindness, we all got our sweet Nana back.
Thank you, Masha!

Masha is a fantastic trainer, patient and gentle, who helped me find the right exercises with my Dalmatian to manage her behavioral issues.

We're now lucky enough to be able to enjoy perfect, relaxed walks thanks to her!

Masha is the best dog coach ever! She loves dogs and her job. She helped me understand dogs much better, and she knows many techniques for training different breeds for different needs. She is also very fun and friendly!
Your dog will be in the right hands! ❤️🐕 …

We were having some problems with Nouga, our 18-month-old corgi. He was pulling on his leash with other dogs. We were told about Masha, who lived near us. Very attentive and calm, she explained how to manage Nouga and why he had been behaving this way before. Walks with Nouga are no longer tiring; it's amazing! Go with complete confidence!

I adopted Django from the animal shelter six months ago, and Masha helped me make sure he was welcomed into my home.

She was with us for those first few months. Django was initially very fearful in the city, but he quickly regained his confidence and is now much more at ease!

Thank you so much, Masha, for all your advice. Your professional support is something I highly recommend!

I consulted Masha about a problem my dog ​​Maggie was having with being alone. She had trouble being by herself and suffered from separation anxiety.

I've been following Masha's recommendations for a month now, and while everything isn't perfect yet, I've already seen real progress. Maggie is becoming more and more independent when I'm home, and I can now leave her alone for short periods, which is already a huge improvement!

Masha is a very attentive, gentle, and caring dog trainer. She gives excellent advice, tailored to both the dog and the owner, and her classes are truly effective.

I highly recommend her to anyone needing help training their dog 🐶
